name: Stakeholder Communication & Lifecycle semantic-family reconciliation
methodology: Keep the nine stakeholder/lifecycle concepts distinct. Their technical subject matter may overlap D1, D4, or D7, but D6 mastery is defined by the stakeholder/lifecycle action the architect must take: discover, explain trade-offs, assign ownership, plan readiness, drive adoption, report outcomes, hand off, govern change, or prioritize a roadmap.
crossDomainBoundary: Do not merge D6 families with technically similar D1/D4/D7 questions unless the tested decision is also stakeholder/lifecycle management. A technical SLA optimization is D1; negotiating an achievable SLA with evidence is D6. Evaluation metric design is D4; reporting business outcomes and aligning sponsors is D6. Runbook mechanics are D7; transfer of ownership and implementation guidance is D6.
contentMutationPolicy: Metadata/selection reconciliation only; no question text is changed in this PR.
